name: android_find_element
description: Finds an element by text (case-insensitive substring), resourceId, or contentDesc and returns its bounds and center. Give at least one of the three.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

text.description: Visible text to search for (case-insensitive substring match).

resourceId.description: Android view ID to search for (e.g. "com.example:id/login_btn").

contentDesc.description: Accessibility content description to search for.
